The user wants me to check the readiness of a UR5e robot, specifically verifying controller activation and joint state availability. This is a read-only inspection task with no movement permission.

According to the instructions:
- I must call `select_skill` once before any other tool
- The skill catalog shows "ur5e.inspect_readiness" which is a read_only_inspection skill
- Required checks are: controllers (trajectory_controller_active, joint_state_broadcaster_active) and joint_state (joint_sample_fresh)
- Success means every required readiness check is freshly observed true

Let me first call `select_skill` with the appropriate skill ID to run the bounded routine.
